authoring_protocol: Adversarial policy test suite. Not independent. Contains highly structured, repeated permutations of 20 underlying entities and uses entities previously exposed during benchmark development. Designed to test edge cases, weak context rejection, and exact-domain resolution.

schema_notes.expected_state: Frozen expected evaluator outcome; never inferred from resolver output.
schema_notes.accepted_domains: Domains accepted as the canonical identity for CONFIDENT cases; empty for negative cases.
schema_notes.ground_truth_relationship: PRIMARY for the requested canonical entity; UNKNOWN where no canonical entity can be safely selected.
schema_notes.context: Only caller-visible identity context; no hidden target company is supplied.
